text.card: A red giant 3,207 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.99 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,983 K at its surface.
